answer: The same signing key proves control of identities on two different chains, and the link is recorded on both so either side can verify it. A Sybil attacker would need the private key itself, not just a copied address, and linking many fake pairs costs one key compromise per pair, so mass linking does not scale. The record keeps every vertex visible, so anyone can audit the handover. When the summit settles over the forge, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
